mapper.sql: id, code, name, category, origin, unit, kg_per_box, boxes_per_pallet, description, stock_qty, safety_qty, location, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM erp_product ORDER BY code
SELECT FROM erp_product WHERE stock_qty < safety_qty ORDER BY (stock_qty - safety_qty)
SELECT FROM erp_product WHERE UPPER(code) = UPPER(#{code})

SELECT FROM erp_product WHERE UPPER(name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(code) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(description) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' ORDER BY code
SELECT FROM erp_product WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_product SET stock_qty = #{stockQty}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_product (code, name, category, origin, unit, kg_per_box, boxes_per_pallet, description, stock_qty, safety_qty, location, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{category}, #{origin}, #{unit}, #{kgPerBox}, #{boxesPerPallet}, #{description}, #{stockQty}, #{safetyQty}, #{location}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
